shared_elements: low-relief carving on a vertical stone monument
justification: Both are vertical stone monuments carved in shallow relief with rounded, cartouche-like forms and repeated circular/disc elements, and both organise motifs into horizontal registers. But A is a three-dimensional figural sculpture in dark, coarse stone dominated by a single body with headdress and pectoral disc, whereas B is a flat, pale stone panel filled edge-to-edge with a regular grid of small, densely packed sign-blocks — a fundamentally different compositional logic and finish.
